rationale: Micah's expertise in visual interfaces for machine learning systems and graph data visualization complements Shiza's work deploying ML models in robotics and haptics—where intuitive interfaces between AI and physical systems are critical. Both operate at the intersection of ML and emerging hardware/XR platforms, and could explore how interactive visualization might improve training, debugging, or operator control in robotic systems.
intro_message: Micah Stubbs, meet Shiza Charania — you're both building at the intersection of ML and physical/spatial interfaces, and Micah's work on visual intuition for AI systems could unlock new possibilities in how operators interact with humanoid robots like Shiza's at Haptile.
